summary: The diff implements a per-caller time zone API and a frontend inline time zone prompt, plus a migration module that preserves existing habit/profile/access-control data and adds an empty per-user time zone map. However, the backend quote system does not meet the spec: the quote list is not the required 50 static quotes, the quote-of-the-day method appears to return only a raw Text string (not text+author+metadata), and there’s no clear evidence that quote rotation state is persisted across upgrades/redeploys or that rotation is deterministic in the required 1→50 loop sequence.

missing_requirements.requirement: Persist per-user fixed time zone setting in canister state such that it survives canister upgrades/redeploys.
missing_requirements.reason: While methods and a `userTimeZones` map exist, the diff does not show `userTimeZones` being stored as stable state (or otherwise persisted via pre/post-upgrade) in `backend/main.mo`. The new migration initializes `userTimeZones` to an empty map, which would drop previously-set time zones on upgrade unless there is additional stable-state wiring not shown.

missing_requirements.requirement: Use the provided static list of 50 quotes and rotate deterministically in order (1→50 then loop) at the user’s local midnight based on their saved fixed UTC offset; rotation must not reset on redeploy/upgrade; expose a single method returning text+author+optional metadata.
missing_requirements.reason: `QUOTES` in `backend/main.mo` contains only 3 entries (not 50). The shown API `getTodaysQuote()` returns `async Text` (not structured text+author(+metadata)). The diff does not provide evidence of persisted rotation state that guarantees the order does not reset across upgrade/redeploy, nor evidence of a deterministic 1→50 loop implementation tied to local-midnight boundaries beyond a local-day computation helper.

missing_requirements.requirement: If the user has not configured a fixed time zone yet, show an inline prompt in the quote area to set it and do not show “Quote unavailable” due to missing configuration.
missing_requirements.reason: The prompt path is implemented, but `DailyMotivationalQuote` still renders the generic error state with the text “Quote unavailable” whenever `error || !quote`. If backend behavior causes `quote` to be absent for reasons related to missing/invalid configuration not captured by `needsTimeZone`, the component would still show “Quote unavailable,” which the requirement asks to avoid for missing configuration scenarios.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add upgrade-safe state migration so introducing persisted quote/time-zone state does not break existing stored data; initialize new persisted structures safely for existing users; no runtime traps after upgrade due to old/missing state.
missing_requirements.reason: A migration module was added, but the diff does not show any corresponding stable-state declarations / preupgrade/postupgrade hooks in `backend/main.mo` that actually use this migration for upgrade safety, nor any initialization for quote-rotation persisted state. The migration sets `userTimeZones` to empty, but does not address quote-rotation persisted state at all.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a migration module that renames `userProfiles` to `habitQuoteUserProfiles` and introduces `habitQuoteUserProfiles` naming in the new actor state.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest requires upgrade-safe migration for adding time-zone/quote state but does not request renaming profile storage fields. This may be incidental but is extra scope not explicitly requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Frontend parses quotes from a single backend string formatted as "Quote text - Author" instead of consuming structured backend fields (text/author).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-2 asks for a backend method that returns text+author (+optional metadata). Implementing string parsing in the frontend implies the backend is not providing structured quote data as requested and adds an unrequested formatting contract.
